methodology.technique: ECC affine stabilization plus OpenCV frame differencing and connected-component transient extraction

interpretation: High-frequency stabilized frame differencing exposes transient motion around the annotated water-drip intervals.
However, the same detector generates large numbers of transient components on clean control clips.
Several clean controls produce stronger elongated residual components than defect_09.
The signal is therefore not sufficiently discriminative for promotion as a generic water-drip trigger.
Further threshold tuning on defect_09 would risk overfitting the development set.
conclusion: Do not promote the transient-motion heuristic. Stop additional Step 42 recall tuning and proceed toward final Step 42 evaluation and documentation.
